_doc: Episode 1 AI story clips approved by the owner. Pipeline: still on Modal (Qwen-Image, A100-80GB) -> strict check -> clip on Modal (Wan2.2 TI2V-5B, L4, 1280x704, 24 fps). Kaggle free clips rejected by owner 2026-10-24 (too soft/low-res). Rule (owner 2026-10-24): motion must play at real-time speed; a slow-motion clip is re-rendered, never just sped up (speeding up makes it too short). Story-detail rule: stills must respect script facts (e.g. the dead man has no boots).
